eyebrow: Who uses it, and for what
header: The same week, three different jobs
lead: A duty manager, a payroll administrator and a shop assistant open Marlbrook Roster for entirely different reasons. Each of them sees the part that is theirs.

panels.title: Duty managers
panels.text: Build the week, approve swaps, cover a sick call at seven in the morning from a phone in the stockroom. The cost line updates as the shift moves, so a decision taken in a hurry is still a costed one.

panels.title: Payroll and finance
panels.text: Close the month once, with corrections already approved and premium rates applied. The export goes straight to the bureau, and the audit trail behind every changed minute stays available for seven years.

panels.title: Staff on the floor
panels.text: See next week as soon as it is published, ask for a day off, offer a shift to a colleague and check how many hours have been recorded this month — without asking anybody in an office.
